messages:
maria: Heads-up team — planning a staggered quiet launch for the Search API change today at 23:00 UTC. Quick checklist and owners below, please ack by 22:30 UTC so we can proceed.

maria: Deploy window: 23:00–00:15 UTC. Canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% (20m ramp).

maria: Owners: deploy=alex, canary-run=qa-liz, rollback=jon, monitoring=samir. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/search-api-launch

alex: I can take deploy. Will do the staggered ramps from the console and watch ingress metrics.

qa-liz: I will run the smoke checklist at each ramp step. Quick note: I need the canary payloads list from Samir to validate KV cache behaviour.

samir: Sending canary payloads in 2: 
```
GET /v1/search?q=test_prefix_1
GET /v1/search?q=test_prefix_2
POST /v1/search {"query": "embedding-check"}
```

samir: Also will watch 95p latency, error rate, and routing failures. I'll post alerts if any trend > 2x baseline for 5m.

jon: I'll be on rollback duty and available via phone if we need to flip the flag. Lokks like no DB schema changes in this deploy?

maria: No DB migrations. This is config + model variant swap. Rollback is feature-flag flip and model-pin revert.

alex: Deploy plan (short):
1) push canary config (1%)
2) wait 10m smoke pass
3) ramp to 5% (monitor 15m)
4) ramp to 25% (monitor 20m)
5) full rollout if green

alex: Command snippets for reference:
```
# push canary
redwoodctl rollout apply --service search-api --variant v2-canary --percent 1
# pinback
redwoodctl rollout apply --service search-api --variant v1 --percent 100
```

qa-liz: Acked. I'll post pass/fail for each step like: "smoke: pass 1%" or "smoke: fail 5% - latency spike"

samir: @qa-liz Can you include the histogram for token latency and the top-5 endpoints affected? speeds help triage.

qa-liz: Will do. Also will run sample traffic through the cache warmer: `curl -X POST https://staging-warm.redwood/prefetch -d @canary_payloads.json`

alex: One question — do we need to warm KV cache before 1%? I can run a small warm job immediately after canary push.

maria: Yes please do the warm job after canary is live. Add 5m buffer then start ramps.

jon: If rollback needed, I'll flip the flag and trigger the pinback command. Who confirms rollback finished? Alex to confirm?

alex: I'll confirm and post a short checklist when pinback completes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for search-api at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z by alex. Canary steps: 1%, 5%, 25%, 100%.

maria: Final asks before 22:30: everyone ack, QA payloads attached, monitoring dashboards up (samir)?

samir: Dashboards up and alert thresholds verified. ack :thumbsup:

qa-liz: ack — payloads attached to the runbook page.

alex: ack — taking deploy. Will ping here at start and after each ramp.

jon: ack — on-call reachable.

maria: Great. If anything unexpected, call the rollback within the first 30m. Otherwise we proceed to full rollout. Thanks all. :rocket:
